description_en: Queries split enterprise monthly bill data based on specified split dimensions and returns the results as download links
description_zh: 通过调用本接口可以根据指定的拆分维度查询拆分版企业月账单数据，结果将以下载链接的形式返回
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen month-bill-split-get --bill-month 202401 --bill-batch 20240101 --bill-split-mode by_invoice_third_part_id --bill-split-key-list invoice_third_part_id123 --x-acs-btrip-so-corp-token feth0000wls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MonthBillSplitGet
